description: He wears a russet-red wool knee-length tunic over a cream linen shirt, with pale gold-tan geometric borders at the neckline, cuffs and hem. A broad dark leather belt is decorated with round metal studs and has a long ornamented hanging end. A dark brown short mantle crosses the shoulders, fastened by a round brooch, with narrow worked edging. Brown trousers and tall dark brown leather boots complete the outfit. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
